reasons: The reported 1.09 clears the critical value of 1.02: it survives correction for all 82,240 specifications in its declared class.

Full-class null: the menu was adaptive, so the logged specifications alone do not license a correction, but the submitted specification lies in the declared class subsets:max_size=3,signs=both (82,240 specifications over 40 features). The Reality Check over that whole class is valid however adaptively the search chose what to evaluate, and conservative, because the class is at least as wide as the search (THEORY.md, P3).
Class source: sandbox. The sandbox refused every specification outside the class during the search, so the class was fixed before the search by construction.

Effective breadth 10.8 of 89 (participation ratio of the trial correlations) is reported for information and not used in the correction: the bootstrap already resamples trials jointly, and shrinking N as well would count their correlation twice (SCOPE.md §10).

Corrects for search breadth only. Trading costs, regime change and look-ahead bias are not checked, and specifications considered but never evaluated are invisible, so this is a lower bound on the correction required.
